name: Gmail (mail.google.com) — the user's flagship 'working with a gmail agent' pitch
description: Gmail — the user's flagship adoption pitch ('as working with gmail agent without paying for google ai plan', docs/verbatim.md:313): mail.google.com buttons and abilities callable as API. NOT an AI chat site — the ui2api surface is the user's own inbox: read the conversation list, search it, open a thread, and (eventually) compose. GOAL 19 static-wire-measured 2026-09-23: mail.google.com is 100% behind the Google auth wall, so EVERY selector below is DOM-unverified pending a captured/attached real session — nothing is claimed verified, nothing is fabricated. Auth class: google web session with the app-bound-cookie caveat (same as youtube posting) — the honest primary seam is the user's own real Chrome attached via UI2API_ATTACH_PORT=9222.
author: ui2api capabilities
siteVersion: Gmail SPA — shell+bundles NOT statically observable (measured 2026-09-23: every path 301/302s to accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin, content-length:0, no JS). Selectors listed from known-stable Gmail UI surface names, explicitly DOM-unverified

transport.protocol: DOM read/write of the site's own rendered UI in the user's own logged-in session (real navigation, real clicks, real typing; reads off the rendered conversation list / opened thread). Gmail's internal RPC bridge (/mail/u/*/_/*) is deliberately NOT driven — no fabricated traffic.

auth.note: MEASURED 2026-09-23: portable cookie replay renders anonymous for Google (browser-bound cookies, same class as youtube posting). The honest primary seam is the user's own real Chrome attached (UI2API_ATTACH_PORT=9222) or a captured session that actually replays.

antiBot.observed: not probed — no session. Google's sign-in/interstitial posture is avoided entirely through the attached real Chrome path.

capabilities.name: Read inbox
capabilities.description: Open mail.google.com/mail/u/0/ in the user's session and read the site's own rendered conversation list: rows carry sender, subject, snippet, date and read/unread state. DOM-UNVERIFIED (auth-walled statically, GOAL 19 measured 2026-09-23) — the known-stable Gmail row surface (table role=row rows with the subject/snippet/date cells) is implemented; the runner honestly re-reads whatever the real session renders and reports ok:false with the measured reason if the sign-in wall shows.
capabilities.method: ui-path (open inbox, read rendered conversation rows)

capabilities.name: List threads (folder / label / query route)
capabilities.description: Navigate the site's own hash route (#label/<Label>, #search/<q>, or the default #inbox) and read the same rendered conversation rows as gmail_read_inbox. DOM-UNVERIFIED (auth-walled statically, GOAL 19 measured 2026-09-23).
capabilities.method: ui-path (navigate the site's label/search view, read rendered rows)

capabilities.name: Open a thread and read it
capabilities.description: Open the first matching thread (or drive a search to find one) by clicking the site's own conversation row, then read the opened thread's subject, from, date and body text off the rendered message pane. DOM-UNVERIFIED (auth-walled statically, GOAL 19 measured 2026-09-23).
capabilities.method: ui-path (click the site's own row, read the opened message pane)

capabilities.name: Search mail
capabilities.description: Type the query into the site's own search box (known-stable surfaces: input[aria-label='Search mail'] / input[name='q']) and press Enter so gmail's own JS runs the search, then read the rendered results. DOM-UNVERIFIED (auth-walled statically, GOAL 19 measured 2026-09-23).
capabilities.method: ui-path (type + Enter in the site's own search box, read results)

capabilities.name: Compose and send an email
capabilities.description: Click the site's own Compose button, fill to/subject/body in the site's own composer fields, click the site's own Send button, and read back the sent confirmation. MUTATION + login-gated by design: dispatched honestly ok:false with login-required until a real captured/attached session exists — NEVER fabricated. DOM-UNVERIFIED (auth-walled statically, GOAL 19 measured 2026-09-23).

auth.capture: npx tsx src/cli.ts profile capture https://mail.google.com --login
auth.note: auth.required:true — no anonymous surface exists (measured 2026-09-23: every mail.google.com path 302s to accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin, content-length:0, no JS bundles fetchable). session.lock stays awaiting-capture. Primary documented seam: the user's own real Chrome attached with mail.google.com signed in (UI2API_ATTACH_PORT=9222).

permissions: read the user's own rendered inbox/list/thread/search results through gmail's own UI (no fabricated traffic, no RPC synthesis)
no mail is ever sent without a real session proof; gmail_send stays login-gated until a live round-trip reads back a sent confirmation
Google app-bound-cookie caveat documented — never claim a portable replay works until it measurably shows the logged-in inbox
builtinProfile: none — Gmail is not a chat site; no ChatDriver profile entry (see REGISTER.md)
analysisMethod: static wire probe only (curl, no browser, no login): every mail.google.com path measured 301/302 → accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin with zero body/bundles → Gmail UI is auth-walled and NOT statically observable. Capability list from known-stable Gmail UI surface names, explicitly DOM-unverified; runners are real Playwright UI paths.
